title: Certify QF_LIA refutations in Lean through the clause log
summary: Quantifier-free linear integer arithmetic (QF_LIA) is now certified end to end through the clause log: integer input is exported, strict bounds are tightened as in Z3's own checker, and cuts and coefficient-free lemmas are proved by Lean's omega tactic. A review fix made wide integer rewrites key each strict atom by its complement, and 520 random instances plus nine documented inputs verify under the standard axioms.
